C1812.title: Tesla Autopilot Lane-Mark Sticker Misdirection Incident
C1812.summary: In March 2019, Tencent Keen Lab disclosed adversarial-example physical attacks against Tesla Model S (firmware v2018.6.1) Autopilot. Research showed just 3 small stickers on the road could fake lane marks, steering Autopilot into oncoming traffic; it also found wiper vision-recognition defects that could be triggered by adversarial images, and remote steering control via a wireless gamepad. This was the first public adversarial-example physical attack on a production-car Autopilot, revealing autonomous-driving vision-perception adversarial fragility.
